info.name: Hourglass API (local)
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Hourglass API, ordered to run top to bottom.

1. Import this collection and `Hourglass.local.postman_environment.json`.
2. Select the **Hourglass Local** environment and set `password` to your app password.
3. Start the app (`npm run dev`), then run folders in order (or Run collection).

The collection adds the `X-Requested-With: hourglass` header to every write automatically (required by the server). Postman keeps the login cookie for you.

exec: // The server requires this header on every write (CSRF guard).

request.description: Set the `password` variable in the Hourglass Local environment first. Limited to 5 attempts per 15 minutes.

exec: // The session cookie (tl_session) is stored by Postman automatically for later requests.

request.description: The server decides what 'today' is (Asia/Kolkata). Run this first; later requests use the dates it saves.

exec: const add = (d, n) => { const x = new Date(d + 'T00:00:00Z'); x.setUTCDate(x.getUTCDate() + n); return x.toISOString().slice(0, 10); };

request.description: Names must be unique (case-insensitive). Name and colour can never change.
Hours that have ended and are still inside the 12-hour logging window.

exec: console.log('No open hours right now: every finished hour is logged or past its window.');

request.description: alignment: toward | neutral | against. energy: 1-5. Optional stopDoingItem: an item id.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('openDate')) { console.log('Skipped: no open hour'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

request.description: Notes are the only change a logged hour allows.
One per day. Locked once saved.

exec: // 409 = today already has one (one per day, locked).
pm.test('body is not returned while sealed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.not.have.property('body'));

request.description: period: day | week | month. Optional from/to (YYYY-MM-DD).
Use Send and Download to save the file.
The server's CSRF guard: every write must carry X-Requested-With: hourglass.
